source_snapshot.bundle: No bundle; sixty attended and sixty machine minutes.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Treats a multi-phase service-action workflow as a simple threshold command.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Restores EEPROM/reset baseline, per-injection count, multi-CPER/EventLog/in-band correlation, physical RMA, and post-replacement validation.
historical_reviews.duplicate_variants: Row 1531 is an HBM thermal-stress test and provides no threshold/RMA evidence for this row.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-07/08 preserve evidence; ED-11/12 gate destructive repetition; ED-36/38 require row/variant identity, complete logs, and engineer verdict.

original_test_intent: Demonstrate that controlled bad-page growth crossing the platform's default RMA threshold produces the expected fatal OAM/UMC threshold evidence and reset behavior, then complete the prescribed qualified replacement and validation lifecycle.
original_method: Preserve state before resetting approved EEPROMs, reboot once, map all devices/OAMs and verify baseline, inject d0/b2/t8 one event at a time while recording counts, stop at first approved threshold exceed, collect every Dump/EventLog/in-band CPER and recovery marker, then separately authorize OAM isolation/replacement and post-replacement stress/health validation.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE sets threshold and approves EEPROM reset/reboot/injection limits; operator controls injections and evidence; qualified hardware personnel replace the OAM; owner decides verdict.
required_inputs: Approved GPU/OAM set and EEPROM-reset scope
Per-injection bad-page accounting and stop rule
safety_requirements: Inject one event at a time
Hard stop at approved crossing or anomaly
No blind retries or repeated reset
agent_execution_scope: Collect approvals, topology, tools, baseline, and stop rules
Perform only approved reset/reboot and counted injections
Make no threshold assumption, hardware action, recovery decision, or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Authorize qualified OAM isolation/replacement and validation
Disposition evidence and issue PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It omits eight-device EEPROM state, reboot, real device/card mapping, count-to-144 narrative, all CPER/EventLog/in-band evidence, mode2/GPU resets, physical RMA, and duplicate-code separation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After phase-specific approvals, reset only named EEPROMs once, reboot, verify baseline, then inject d0/b2/t8 one event at a time with recorded counts and a hard stop at the first approved threshold crossing.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: devices 0..7 reset, reboot/warm reset, amdgpu load, d0/b2/t8, source 128/144 values, complete OOB/in-band/RMA lifecycle, no bundle, 60/60 minutes.

modernized_recommendation.status: MULTI-GATE BAD-PAGE THRESHOLD AND QUALIFIED RMA LIFECYCLE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use immutable phase manifests for baseline/reset, counted injection, threshold event, recovery, physical replacement, and post-validation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces uncontrolled sequential injection and selective CPER retrieval with deterministic limits and complete evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Threshold event evidence does not prove EEPROM reset or RMA completion; physical replacement does not prove the original crossing.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Repeated poison can permanently retire pages, reset or lose GPUs, take the node out of service, and require OAM replacement.

project_override_considerations: Do not merge row 1531 thermal-stress evidence. Do not infer 128 is authoritative or target 144 unless approved. RMA cannot be marked complete from a suggested-action field alone.
expected_evidence: All protected Dump/EventLog/attachments and in-band CPER
Fatal UMC ext0 threshold, OAM, critical message, mode2/GPU reset and restored state correlation
Qualified replacement record, post-validation, and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Code is reused by unrelated row 1531. Procedure implies default threshold 128/count 144 while prior review expects an operator-provided parameter; it clears EEPROM/logs, uses raw HTTP/max-ID, allows up to three CPER but highlights only one, and embeds insecure transfer. DeepSeek omits most destructive and physical coverage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review and variant isolation are complete; execution depends on supplyable threshold, approvals, packages, recovery, and qualified personnel.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2090 Wistron-AMD SVM-00134-V003: preserve it apart from row 1531 HBM thermal stress; approve authoritative default/driver threshold, GPU/OAM reset and reboot scope, counted injection stop rule, complete CPER/EventLog/mode2 evidence, recovery, qualified RMA/replacement, and post-validation.

review_improvement: Maintains the full threshold-to-RMA lifecycle while separating destructive phases, duplicate identity, and evidence obligations.
independent_technical_reasoning: EEPROM reset changes the historical bad-page denominator, so baseline evidence must precede it. A threshold claim requires the configured value, pre-count, every injection, and first crossing—not a final example count. Multiple CPERs and eight mode2 entries are expected system reactions and must be reconciled rather than selecting one file. AFID/SAG RMA advice is diagnostic evidence only; actual replacement and post-validation are distinct human service actions.
